precondition: An active individual with completed required MFA sends a syntactically valid request.
obligation: No approved global capability/procedure exists. Return uniform boundary unavailable without target lookup, attempt reservation or mutation. 503 cannot certify any earlier uncertain outcome.
limitations: Schema/example/consumer evidence only; no server authorization, session revocation, durable storage, audit, crash recovery or queued delivery has executed. Actual security/domain/P03/P24 implementation and reviews remain gates.

precondition: Actor is Chapter Head in one or more chapters only.
obligation: Return safe 403. Chapter Head may separately end memberships/grants only in its currently authorized chapter/scope. Never disable global identity by inference.
limitations: Schema/example/consumer evidence only; no server authorization, session revocation, durable storage, audit, crash recovery or queued delivery has executed. Actual security/domain/P03/P24 implementation and reviews remain gates.

precondition: Actor has provisioner or recovery_operator only, including a provider who also has a separately approved chapter membership.

precondition: The individual has incomplete MFA, invalid origin or an expired CSRF proof.
obligation: Reject restricted state/origin with 403 and valid-session CSRF mismatch with 419 before target/result resolution. Shared cookie/token rotation policy applies; no successful mutation replay is offered.
limitations: Schema/example/consumer evidence only; no server authorization, session revocation, durable storage, audit, crash recovery or queued delivery has executed. Actual security/domain/P03/P24 implementation and reviews remain gates.

precondition: A prepared mutation or original uncertain lookup outlives session expiry/revocation/identity disable.
obligation: 401 reveals no target or result. Preserve original immutable attempt and uncertainty, conceal protected edits, and require the same still-active identity/current original authority before any later authorized lookup. Reauthentication cannot restore disabled/revoked authority.
limitations: Schema/example/consumer evidence only; no server authorization, session revocation, durable storage, audit, crash recovery or queued delivery has executed. Actual security/domain/P03/P24 implementation and reviews remain gates.

precondition: An original mutation may have committed before its reply was lost; current lookup is newly denied or unavailable.
obligation: 403/503 are new lookup failures, never proof of earlier rejection. No operation/result/identity fields are disclosed. No automatic new key, mutation resend, actor/scope substitution or global enumeration.
limitations: Schema/example/consumer evidence only; no server authorization, session revocation, durable storage, audit, crash recovery or queued delivery has executed. Actual security/domain/P03/P24 implementation and reviews remain gates.

precondition: A caller uses numeric target ID or illegal provider/chapter selectors.

limitations: Schema/example/consumer evidence only; no server authorization, session revocation, durable storage, audit, crash recovery or queued delivery has executed. Actual security/domain/P03/P24 implementation and reviews remain gates.
